projects.title: Laravel Modular Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a configurable admin dashboard with Laravel Blade templates.
projects.extendedDescription: I developed a highly configurable admin dashboard using Laravel Blade templates, focusing on flexibility, performance, and ease of customization. The solution allows administrators to manage interface components, layouts, and dynamic data displays without modifying core code, making the dashboard scalable and adaptable to different business needs. By leveraging Blade's templating capabilities, reusable components, and clean structure, the system ensures maintainability while providing a streamlined and user-friendly experience for both developers and end-users.

projects.title: Laravel GetText Package
projects.description: Extended compatibility to PHP 8.1 and Laravel 9 for multilingual support.
projects.extendedDescription: I extended the system's compatibility to PHP 8.1 and Laravel 9 to ensure improved performance, stability, and long-term maintainability, while also enabling robust multilingual support. This upgrade allowed the application to leverage the latest framework enhancements, modern language features, and better localization tools, ultimately providing a more seamless and scalable environment for serving users across different regions and languages.

projects.title: CSED 2020 Yearbook
projects.description: Created a memorial website including backend and layout in Laravel Blade.
projects.extendedDescription: I created a memorial website that included both the backend functionality and the full layout implementation using Laravel Blade. The project focused on delivering a clean, respectful, and user-friendly experience, allowing visitors to view memories, stories, and tributes through an organized and visually appealing interface. By building the backend from scratch and designing the Blade templates for the front-end, I ensured a seamless integration between data management and presentation, resulting in a stable and meaningful platform for preserving and sharing memories.

projects.title: Curey Healthcare App
projects.description: Graduation project focused on backend API and database systems
projects.extendedDescription: My graduation project focused on designing and implementing robust backend APIs and database systems, emphasizing scalability, security, and efficient data management. I structured the API to support clean integration with various front-end clients, while the database architecture was optimized for performance and reliability. Through this project, I gained hands-on experience with system design principles, API lifecycle management, and data modeling, resulting in a solid and well-documented backend foundation.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: My personal portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS.
projects.extendedDescription: I built my personal portfolio website using React and Tailwind CSS, focusing on delivering a clean, modern, and responsive user experience. The site showcases my projects, skills, and professional background through a visually appealing layout powered by reusable React components and Tailwind's utility-first styling. By optimizing performance and ensuring seamless navigation across devices, the portfolio serves as an effective platform for presenting my work and personal brand.

projects.title: Kiro Pet Supplies
projects.description: Bulk-ordering platform that replaces a pet-supply wholesaler's paper notes and chat threads.
projects.extendedDescription: A catalog and ordering platform built for a pet-supply wholesaler that used to run bulk orders through paper notes, phone calls and memory. Shop owners register their store locations, browse a price-free catalog, and submit an order that becomes a durable record from the first moment. The admin reviews each order, adjusts quantities and prices against real availability, and every change is logged as a discrete event, so there is always a clear audit trail of what was agreed. Finalised orders produce a PDF invoice that is sent to the customer over WhatsApp. The system is bilingual (English and Arabic), ships as installable PWAs for both customers and admins, and includes a Filament admin dashboard with spreadsheet import/export. This is a commercial product: the source code is not public, and installations are available on request.

projects.title: Varden
projects.description: HR and resource management platform: timesheets, PTO, leave and HR requests with a versioned API.
projects.extendedDescription: An HR and resource management system covering the employee lifecycle end to end. HR manages employees, departments, work locations and the reporting hierarchy, with a full employment-history trail. Employees log monthly timesheets across projects and leave types, and submissions flow through a one-level manager-then-HR approval engine. A PTO ledger keeps append-only balances with per-location policies, holiday calendars, weekend and holiday work credits, sick-leave documentation review and year-end payouts, alongside a yearly vacation planner and team calendar. A request-type builder lets HR configure their own request workflows without a developer. It ships with a Blade UI and a documented, versioned JSON API (Sanctum-authenticated) on the same business logic, and is tested on both PostgreSQL and MySQL. This is a commercial product: the source code is not public, and installations are available on request.
